doc:
F-0507: Graph.KG.TemporalIndex.Purge() kills every graph's temporal stores and retracts no marked row; the
    rows then outlive every timestamp and purge_before cannot find them.
oracle: ADR-0009 amendment: the marked row goes when the triple's last timestamp goes, in every graph
verdict: both graphs' temporal stores wiped; marked rows and adjacency survive every purge
